## Goal
`src/freemyid/wizard/firstrun.py` (front end, in-house) has no direct test anywhere in `tests/`.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. `system_browser` (22-26): with `shutil.which` returning None and `Path.exists` true for exactly one of the Windows paths (14-19) it returns that path; a `which` hit takes priority; None when nothing is found.
2. `ensure_browser` (33-42) with injected `ask`/`run`: a system browser -> `system`, and neither `ask` nor `run` is called; any answer not starting with y (`""`, `n`, `no`, `N`, spaces) -> `declined` and `run` is never called; `y`, `Y`, ` yes ` -> `installed` and `run` is called once with `browser_install_command()` and `check=True`.
3. `browser_install_command` (29-30) uses `sys.executable` and installs chromium only.
4. The question (37-38) states the download size and contains none of the words docs/POSITIONING.md bans.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Offline: no network, no sockets (FastAPI `TestClient` is fine), no git, no installs, no new dependencies. Tests must pass on Windows CI too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp`, no `/`-joined path strings or other POSIX-only assumptions (WO-217 broke windows-latest that way). The module under test is outside Codex's code lane: a real product bug = `pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=...)` plus a finding with file:line in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit it. Check `tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first and don't duplicate a guard. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them in your worktree.
